Hi all,

Finance ops note: we operationally support two patterns for Azure Private Plan settlements:

1) Consolidated billing to customer AP: Redwood issues a single consolidated monthly invoice to Medsprint covering committed reservation + usage. Marketplace remittances from Azure are tracked separately; we include a sell-through line and a CSV reconciliation. Practically this creates a timing gap because Azure typically remits in ~30-45 days; to manage cashflow we apply a short holdback on the sell-through component (we can discuss %).

2) Merchant split: Azure invoices Medsprint directly for marketplace-collected fees and Redwood invoices for Redwood-controlled items. Simpler for Redwood cashflow, but more work for Medsprint to reconcile two invoice sources.

If you prefer consolidated billing well need Medsprints tax/withholding forms and AP contact. Our initial proposal is a 5% holdback until Azure remits, but I'm open to negotiating down to something like 3% if legal accepts an explicit remittance statement and adjustment workflow.

Attached is our invoice-routing diagram for reference.

Ben Carter
Revenue Ops

Please see attached redline to your MSA and the sell-through exhibit with specific clauses on recoupment, credits, and tax handling.

Alicia

Thanks for the redline. Proposed compromise to keep execution moving:
- Holdback: Redwood accepts 3% holdback on sell-through, remitted within 30 days of Azure payout.
- Adjustments: Redwood will net Azure post-invoice adjustments on the subsequent invoice cycle and provide a reconciliation CSV. For material disputes (> $5,000/month) we will open a joint review and if needed issue a credit memo.
- Statements: Redwood will provide a monthly remittance CSV aligned with Azure payouts (fields: month, sku, committed, consumed, marketplace fee, gross remittance, net remittance).

If Medsprint confirms the $5k dispute threshold and accepts the remittance timing, Ben can collect tax form and AP contact and I will prepare the final SOW exhibit language for signature.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
